arc: hook → problem → transition → reveal → benefit ×2 → feature ×2 → feature ×3 (wheel) → logo → cta

scenes.title: Blur-in kinetic headline 'Selling online / is a…' on a faint grid
scenes.summary: Pale #F6F9FC page with a faint navy grid fading to the edges and a blurple→violet→cyan horizon glow breathing at the bottom. 'Selling' blurs in, 'online' ripples in letter by letter in slate, the line lifts and blurs away, then 'is' and 'a' rise in one word at a time while 'pain' sits at 16% opacity waiting for the cut. A very slow push-in scales the type throughout; the sentence is completed by the next scene.
scenes.build: Orthographic px stage (orthoStage). Each word is makeText/makeChars from components/type.ts, which renders a sharp and a pre-blurred canvas twin so set(opacity, blur) crossfades sharp↔soft for the blur-in. The grid is gridTexture(fade) and the glow a backdrop() canvas plane from components/fx.ts; timing via interpolate + Easing.
scenes.reuse: Borrow for any opening sentence that builds word by word with a blur/rise and a per-character ripple on one word; swap the copy and colours. The trailing dim word ('pain') is a trick for handing a sentence across a cut — drop it if the next scene doesn't complete the line.

scenes.title: 'a pain' printed on a 3D grid floor → light streak → red tile morphs into a puck
scenes.summary: Top-down view of a pale grid floor with 'a pain' printed on it in navy (the dot of the i is a separate blurple dot). The camera tilts from straight-down to near the horizon, the type dissolves, and the i's dot lifts into a glowing blurple light that streaks across the floor. A glossy red tile (the hassle) drops in and spins to rest; the light parks, then strikes it — the tile turns blurple, folds into a glossy blurple puck with a floor ripple, and the puck extrudes upward into the column the next scene opens inside.
scenes.build: Perspective camera driven by splineKeys (C1 Catmull-Rom/Hermite) over orbit params [target, radius, pitch, yaw]; the light rides a second spline and its streak is a 4-vertex BufferGeometry rebuilt each frame from head/tail positions, billboarded toward the camera. Floor is a repeating canvas texture with '+' corner marks; tile is a bevelled ExtrudeGeometry slab with MeshPhysicalMaterial clearcoat lit by studioEnvLight (components/linkmark.ts). Tile→puck is a 6-frame colour lerp + scale morph, not a swap.
scenes.reuse: Use when a problem word should physically become an object: type laid on a floor, a dot that turns into a light, a 'pain' token struck and transformed into your product's shape. Swap the word, tile colour (red = problem) and puck colour. The dotless-ı trick to free the i's dot is reusable for any word with an i. Don't copy the Stripe blurple palette verbatim for another brand.

scenes.title: Chain-link coin flips up inside a blurple glass column
scenes.summary: Under one second: a vertical blurple glass band with bright edges fills the centre of a pale frame and narrows to its resting width while a glossy blurple coin bearing a chrome chain-link mark flips up from below, tumbles edge-on, settles facing camera, then turns edge-on again for the cut.
scenes.build: perspStage camera; blurpleColumn() from components/column.ts is an opaque full-frame canvas band; linkCoin() from components/linkmark.ts is a CylinderGeometry with clearcoat face and a TubeGeometry chain-link mark. The coin pose is one splineKeys curve over [y, rotX, rotY, rotZ, scale] keys so it never stops on a key.
scenes.reuse: Only as a bridge between the puck in 02 and the mark in 04. For a coin-flip reveal with more payoff, look at 10-coin-stablecoins, which repeats this exact move and then builds a lockup on it.

scenes.title: 'Meet [3D link mark] Payment Links' lockup with a motion-blurred whip
scenes.summary: A studio backdrop of a faint 219px grid with blurple diamond markers and a diagonal blurple→violet→cyan light beam. A glossy blurple 3D chain-link mark turns out of edge-on while 'Meet' blurs in to its left. 'Meet' dims away, the mark slides left and 'Payment Links' un-blurs in beside it to form the lockup; the studio fades to plain page and the lockup drifts slowly larger. At the end it whips left and swells, smeared by real sub-frame motion blur, leaving a blurple streak behind.
scenes.build: perspStage; the mark is linkGeometry() (two interlocking TubeGeometry stadium loops) with a clearcoat MeshPhysicalMaterial on studioEnvLight. The whip's motion blur is the lockup built K=28 times, each copy posed a fraction of a frame earlier and drawn at low opacity — a shutter. Lockup pose is a keyed [x, scale] table with easing only on the drift segment; type uses makeText blur twins.
scenes.reuse: The 'Meet X' → name lockup is a reusable reveal beat; swap the 3D mark geometry and wordmark. The K-copy sub-frame shutter is a strong technique for any fast whip/exit in Three.js. Don't reuse the Stripe/Payment Links naming.

scenes.title: 'No code' slams in behind a lightning-bolt speed streak
scenes.summary: Eighteen frames. Faint horizontal rules with a few blurple '+' marks; a fat blurple streak with a white lightning bolt in its round head accelerates left→right across centre, crossfading from blurple to a cyan→blurple→violet gradient. Italic navy 'No code' decelerates in from the right above it with its blur clearing, and a violet glow swells on the right edge as the streak exits.
scenes.build: orthoStage; the streak is a 2500px canvas (streakCanvas) — tapered polygon + round head drawn twice (blurred glow pass + body) with a bolt path — moved along a keyed head-x table. Two streak planes crossfade for the colour shift. 'No code' is makeText with skew 0.2 for a synthetic italic and a blur twin.
scenes.reuse: Too short to stand alone; it exists to carry the streak from 04 into 06. Borrow the streakCanvas drawing (tapered streak + glowing head + glyph) if you need a speed streak.

scenes.title: Pulse runs a circuit board, nodes light up: 'Share' → 'Global'
scenes.summary: A pale studio with a lilac corner glow and a circuit board of grey traces and five rounded-square nodes. A violet streak runs in along the input trace, cooling to blurple, while 'Share' blurs in large on the left; it strikes node 2 and the nodes light blurple one after another down the tree with a glow flash. The studio drops away, the traces turn into gradient (cyan/blurple/pink/amber) solid lines then dashes, the nodes become pink/violet outlines, 'Share' dissolves and 'Global' blurs in low right. The camera pulls back and drifts, then the board softens out.
scenes.build: Ortho 'world' group moved/scaled by splineKeys over [N2 screen x, y, scale] keys as the camera. Routes are drawn three times into canvases (solid / warm gradient / dashed with setLineDash and arcTo corners) and crossfaded; each node is three stacked planes (dark, lit, outline) from nodeTexture() plus a glowSprite flash, timed by a LIT frame array.
scenes.reuse: Good for 'how it flows', data/money routing, or a pair of benefit words over a network diagram. Swap the NODES/ROUTES arrays for your topology and the two words. The style-swap of the whole board mid-shot (solid → dashed) is a nice way to change the message without a cut.

scenes.title: Phone checkout → payment success with whip transitions
scenes.summary: Light lilac-tinted studio with '+' marks and dust. A phone rises from below showing a Stripe-hosted checkout (Clay & Co., Ceramic mug, $32.00, email and card fields, blurple 'Pay $32.00' button) while 'Checkout In Seconds' builds word by word above it. A downward whip carries phone and title off; a second, larger phone showing 'Payment successful' with a big blurple check drops in from the top and settles as 'Get Paid Anywhere' builds below. Everything whips off left, motion-blurred.
scenes.build: orthoStage; phones are phoneMesh() from components/phone.ts (rim, bezel, dynamic island, status bar drawn to one 2× canvas) with screens checkoutScreen / successScreenCheck from components/phone-light.ts. Whip blur = K=7 cloned phones posed a fraction of a frame apart at 0.3 opacity. Positions are keyed px tables (top/bottom edges) eased with easeOutCubic; titles are per-word makeText with rise + blur-in.
scenes.reuse: Use for a two-step mobile flow (form → success) with a headline per step. Swap the canvas screen draw functions and the two headlines. The phone/screen drawing is generic; the product (mug, Clay & Co.) and Stripe styling are template content.

scenes.title: 'Create a payment link' dashboard window slides in under 'Built For Every Business'
scenes.summary: Pale studio with blurple and cyan corner glows and dust top-right. A white desktop window slides in from the right, smeared, and settles low-centre: sidebar with a chain-link badge, 'Create a payment link' form — Ceramic mug product, $32.00 USD, checked 'Collect shipping address' and 'Show confirmation page', 'Adjustable' quantity, '40+ methods', tax field, Cancel and blurple 'Create link' buttons. 'Built For Every Business' builds word by word above; slow push-in, then a downward whip drops everything out.
scenes.build: The whole window UI is one canvas painted by drawWindow() into a backdrop() plane (helpers roundRect, drawChain, drawMug, softShadow from components/ui.ts). Slide-in and exit whip blur use K=12 cloned planes offset by sub-frame time; a stage group carries the push scale.
scenes.reuse: Template for any 'dashboard form' feature beat: replace drawWindow with your own UI canvas and change the headline. Keep the smear-clone technique for slides. The form copy is Stripe-specific.

scenes.title: Three-segment wheel: Products / Recurring / Donations, each with a sliding slab
scenes.summary: On a dotted pale ground, a wheel of three glassy annular segments around a white hub with a glossy blurple 3D chain-link falls in from the top spinning and settles. Each use case then gets a beat: its segment lights with blurred inner colour glows, a tinted slab that wraps the ring slides in from its side (blurple from the left, violet from the bottom right, pink from the top right), and white copy lands on it — 'Products / Sell anything, one link each', 'Recurring / Subscriptions, billed for you', 'Donations / Let supporters pick the amount'. At the end the wheel spins away.
scenes.build: orthoStage; segments are 820px canvas textures from segmentTexture() (sectorPath annular sector, blurred rim halo, random blurred colour blobs seeded by mulberry32) with dim and lit copies crossfaded. Slabs are full-frame backdrop canvases whose path follows an arc of radius 412 around the wheel, with a destination-out fade. A BEATS array [slab, copy, segment, in, out, slide-from] drives everything.
scenes.reuse: Great for presenting 3 products/plans/use cases around a central mark. Change SEGS colours, the three heads/sublines and the centre mark. For 4+ items you must redo the sector angles and slab paths. Don't keep the Stripe link mark.

scenes.title: Coin flips in, glides into a trio of floating coins under 'Powered by Stripe'
scenes.summary: The blurple glass column returns and a big glossy link coin flips in edge-on and lands. The column keeps widening and dissolves into a light lavender wedge of light while the same coin glides down and shrinks into the front slot of a trio; two more coins drift in from depth on the left and right. 'Powered by' and the blurple Stripe wordmark rise in at the top, the coins bob gently, then the light and the left coin let go into the end card.
scenes.build: perspStage; one continuous shot merging two old scenes. Hero coin = linkCoin inside a 'roll' group, posed by a splineKeys FLIP table then lerped to its trio slot with easeInOutCubic; column width via splineKeys COL. stripeWordmark() in components/brand.ts draws the real Stripe SVG paths into a canvas. setOpacity() keeps coins in the transparent pass so they sort over depthTest-off backdrops.
scenes.reuse: Use the persisting-element glide (big hero object shrinks into one slot of a group) for a 'powered by / backed by' or partner beat. Swap coins for your objects and the wordmark for your partner logo. The Stripe wordmark is a real trademark — never carry it into another brand's video.

scenes.title: App-icon end card: wordmark slides out from behind the icon + mono CTA URL
scenes.summary: Back in the grid-and-diamond studio with the diagonal blurple/violet/cyan beam. A blurple rounded app icon with a white chrome chain-link blurs in near centre and glides left; 'Payment Links' and the two-line tagline 'Create a link. / Sell anywhere.' slide out from behind it, clipped at the icon's right edge. 'GET STARTED' and 'STRIPE.COM/PAYMENTS/PAYMENT-LINKS' fade up below in JetBrains Mono, then the frame holds for ~5s with the beam drifting and the mark gently rocking.
scenes.build: perspStage; the icon tile is a canvas (radial gradient, dot texture, gradient stroke) with a linkGeometry mark in chromeLight material. The 'slides out from behind' effect is a THREE.Plane clipping plane (renderer.localClippingEnabled) whose constant tracks the icon's right edge each frame, applied to the wordmark/tagline materials. Positions are keyed px tables.
scenes.reuse: A clean reusable end card: app icon + name + tagline + mono URL. Swap icon art, name, tagline and URL; the clipping-plane reveal works for any 'text emerges from behind a logo'. The URL and Payment Links naming are Stripe's.
